name: CoreAlert
description: Inline alert banner with type-based icon, optional description, dismissible close button, and trailing action slot
descriptionFull:
Inline alert banner with type-based icon, optional description, dismissible close button, and trailing action slot.

Announced assertively by default, which suits a message that appears in response to something the user just did. A banner that is simply part of the page should pass `role` to say so — see the prop's docs

props.name: type
props.description: Controls the color scheme and default icon

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role for the wrapper, which decides whether screen readers announce it. `'alert'` is an assertive live region — it…
props.descriptionFull: ARIA role for the wrapper, which decides whether screen readers announce it. `'alert'` is an assertive live region — it interrupts whatever the reader is saying. Right for a message that appears in response to something the user just did, wrong for a banner that is simply part of the page: that one is re-announced on every mount, so it interrupts on every navigation. `'status'` announces politely; `'none'` renders no live region at all (the attribute is omitted)

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary/detail content shown below the title

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Renders the type icon (or the `icon` override) before the content

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon (used when showIcon is true)

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows an ✕ button; clicking it hides the alert

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when close button is clicked

props.name: banner
props.description: Display as full-width banner (no border radius, no margin)

props.name: action
props.description: Action element rendered to the right
